rules.instruction: When the description says that an activity may recur and that each occurrence requires a subsequent activity to happen again.: Model the recurring behavior with a gateway-controlled path that ensures each occurrence is followed by the required subsequent activity, rather than using only a one-time direct sequence.
rules.situation: the description says that an activity may recur and that each occurrence requires a subsequent activity to happen again.

rules.instruction: When the description says that actions happen simultaneously and that a later action follows one of them while remaining independent of the activities on another concurrent branch.: Model the concurrent actions on separate parallel branches. Put the later action on the branch it follows, and do not make it wait for an unrelated branch to finish. Synchronize branches only when the description requires them to reunite.
rules.situation: the description says that actions happen simultaneously and that a later action follows one of them while remaining independent of the activities on another concurrent branch.

rules.instruction: When the description states that two or more actions occur at the same time, or that one action is independent of another after a shared prerequisite: Model the actions on separate branches from a parallel gateway. Use a parallel join only before a continuation that requires all those branches to finish.
